tier1.notes: Fixes an update that installed correctly but could still report that it had failed. Tapping Install more than once sent the receiver the same update several times over; they collided and the receiver answered one of them with an error, while the update itself was already succeeding. The receiver now accepts one update at a time and says so plainly instead. Nothing unsafe ever happened -- every update is signature-checked before it is installed. Installs from the app in a few seconds; no card removal.

tier2.notes: Reflash required only if your receiver is older than 0.24.40 -- newer units can take this over the air from the app. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher -- not Raspberry Pi Imager, whose WiFi/hostname presets conflict with the receiver. Do not decompress the file first.
